Record Class IdentityView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.who.admin.IdentityView
Record Components:
id - the identity's id
status - whether it may sign in
createdAt - when it was created
roles - the names of the roles it holds, sorted
emailAddresses - its email addresses, sorted; empty without email sign-in
credentials - how many sign-in credentials it holds, by kind (email, passkey, account); empty when who cannot count them
public record IdentityView(UUID id, IdentityStatus status, Instant createdAt, List<String> roles, List<String> emailAddresses, Map<String,Long> credentials) extends Record
An identity as who's admin endpoints show it.
